chunks: "Whoever takes hold of the handles of the bier, Allah will forgive for him twenty-five major sins, and when he carries it on all four sides, he comes out from sins."

key_terms.السَّرِيرِ: the bier or funeral couch of the deceased
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِقَوَائِمِ: by the handles or sides used to carry the bier
key_terms.رَبَّعَ: carried the bier from all four sides

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for carrying the bier in a funeral according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages participation in funeral rites, especially carrying the bier. It highlights the great spiritual reward and forgiveness associated with serving the deceased and joining the funeral procession.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.459 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever takes hold of the handles of the bier, Allah (swt) will forgive twenty-five major sins for them. And if they carry it on all four sides, they will be cleansed of their sins."
